backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining RoseDayWish and Bouquet data models with CRUD operations and sorted queries using in-memory and persistent maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two bouquet-select related frontend fixes with affected files, components, tests, and confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of all major frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining color tokens, dark mode values, and global layout styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining routes for home, wish CRUD pages, bouquet maker, and bouquet viewer wrapped in AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout with header navigation, themed background, footer attribution, and slot for page content.
frontend/src/components/BouquetPreview.t: Interactive or static bouquet preview component rendering a flower grid, wrapping and ribbon info, and optional click handler.
frontend/src/components/CopyLinkButton.t: Button that copies a given URL to the clipboard with visual feedback toggling between copy and check icons.
frontend/src/components/RomanticGif.tsx: Memoized GIF component that displays an image with error fallback text.
frontend/src/components/RomanticGifPicke: Grid picker UI for selecting a romantic GIF option with visual highlighting.
frontend/src/components/SecretReveal.tsx: Dialog that reveals a bouquet’s secret message and optional image.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBouquet.ts: React Query hooks for creating and fetching bouquets using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider handling Internet Identity auth client, login, logout, and identity lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useWish.ts: React Query hooks for creating, editing, and fetching wishes via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with theme variables, dark mode, utilities, and print styles.
frontend/src/lib/bouquetOptions.ts: Static lists of flower types, colors, wrapping styles, and ribbon styles.
frontend/src/lib/bouquetSelect.ts: Helpers for mapping bouquet IDs to select-safe values and back.
frontend/src/lib/romanticGifs.ts: Defines available romantic GIF metadata and helpers to retrieve them.
frontend/src/lib/shareLinks.ts: Functions to build shareable URLs for wishes and bouquets.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query, identity provider, and rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/BouquetMakerPage.tsx: Provides a form to configure and create a bouquet with optional secret messages, then displays a shareable link after creation.
frontend/src/pages/CreateWishPage.tsx: Form for creating a personalized wish with optional bouquet and GIF selection, returning a shareable link once saved.
frontend/src/pages/EditWishPage.tsx: Loads an existing wish for editing, validates inputs, and updates the wish before redirecting to its view page.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page showcasing features and navigation buttons for creating wishes or bouquets.
frontend/src/pages/ViewBouquetPage.tsx: Displays a created bouquet with share and print options, and handles revealing any associated secret message.
frontend/src/pages/ViewWishPage.tsx: Renders a wish view page that loads wish and bouquet data, shows a romantic GIF, displays wish details, and provides edit, share, and print actions with loading and error states.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, radii, shadows, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s current state, features, known issues, and metadata for the Rose Day website.
